results.content:
4.5

Based on 14 reviews

Review Ngrok?

Reviewers mostly see Ngrok as a fast, easy way to share local work for development, testing, debugging, and demos, with clear docs and an intuitive setup. One founder of Chert also calls it “frictionless tunneling,” reinforcing that technical strength. But the praise is tempered by complaints about missing basic features, high pricing for custom domains, and especially account and billing policies: one user reports abrupt bans that disrupted customer demos, while another says annual subscription cancellation is unnecessarily hard.

I've been following this service for a while now and will continue. I do think the pricing could be more competitive and I hope to see their model evolve over time. Great work, ngrok team.
